news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, with the agency aligning on the planned content and format of the submission. The company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit the NDA in late Q4 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Abivax S.A. (ABVX.US) With Buy Rating, Raises Target Price to $180
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reiterated its Overweight/Buy rating on Abivax and lifted its price target to $180 from $132, citing growing confidence in obefazimod's regulatory path and commercial prospects in ulcerative colitis.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four senior commercial executives (heads of marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access), several with prior Amgen/Takeda experience, as it builds a standalone U.S. commercial organization ahead of the planned obefazimod NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: In a CNBC interview, Abivax's CEO said the company's newly raised $920 million gives it the firepower to launch obefazimod independently in the U.S. rather than pursue a sale, pushing back on ongoing takeover speculation.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized, oversubscribed ADS offering priced at $125 per share, raising roughly $874 million in net proceeds and extending its cash runway into Q4 2029 to fund the obefazimod launch.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod, Demonstrating Meaningful Clinical Benefit in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 maintenance data showed 37.2% of induction non-responders achieved clinical remission at Week 44 on continued 50mg obefazimod, and exposure-adjusted malignancy rates across the integrated Phase 2/3 program remained within expected ulcerative colitis background ranges. The results strengthened the safety database ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and helped trigger the subsequent $920M capital raise.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis; a positive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026 confirmed alignment on content/format, and no new safety signals have emerged since.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA submission (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for filing a Marketing Authorization Application with the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar sets September 21, 2026 for its first-half 2026 results and business update, including cash runway and regulatory progress; Q3 2026 results are calendared for December 14, 2026.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. commercial launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Following the recently built-out commercial leadership team and the $920M raise (runway into Q4 2029), Abivax is preparing for a standalone U.S. launch if/when obefazimod is approved.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction data
catalysts.detail: Obefazimod's Phase 2b induction trial in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease (ENHANCE-CD) is ongoing; company guidance on the induction readout timing has ranged from late 2026 to mid-2027.

catalysts.label: M&A / takeover speculation
catalysts.detail: Eli Lilly was reported (Jan 2026) to be circling a ~€15bn takeover, and French media reported AstraZeneca had exclusive data-room access with a March 23, 2026 deadline to bid; Abivax denied that report, no formal offer from either party has been confirmed, and the CEO has since emphasized a path to going it alone after the $920M raise.

pulse: Abivax enters the second half of 2026 well-capitalized and de-risked on the regulatory front: positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 data in late June (with malignancy rates in line with UC background levels) cleared the way for a $920M ADS offering that closed in early July, extending cash runway into Q4 2029, and a positive July 30 pre-NDA meeting with the FDA kept the company on track for a late-Q4 2026 NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, alongside a planned H2 2026 EU MAA filing. New commercial leadership hires signal the company is building toward an independent U.S. launch rather than a sale, even as earlier-2026 takeover chatter (Eli Lilly in January, an AstraZeneca report in March that was denied) remains an overhang analysts still reference. No major company-specific news has broken since the July 30 FDA update; the next scheduled catalyst is the H1 2026 results release on September 21, 2026.
